password.title: Password
password.body: After changing it you'll be signed out everywhere and asked to sign in again.

showroom.title: Showroom password
showroom.body: Used only on the showroom tablet. It must differ from your dashboard password.
showroom.saved: Showroom password changed. Showroom tablets must sign in again.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification (2FA)
twoFactor.bodyOff: Protect your account with a 6-digit code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…).
twoFactor.bodyOn: Signing in asks for a code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.remaining: {count, plural, =0 {No recovery codes left} one {# recovery code left} other {# recovery codes left}}
twoFactor.stepScan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
twoFactor.recoveryBody: Each code works once if you lose your phone. Store them somewhere safe — they won't be shown again.
